# E-M5 III 1.7: native Live ND menu rows, values after power-off

The rows appear in place, the page opens, and set values are still there after a restart.

**physical camera; reported pass; partial report; not applicable.**

**Camera:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md) · **Project:** [Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)

**Firmware:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Mod build:** unpublished test build (2026-11-19)

**Provenance:** firsthand tester report. **Reported:** 2026-11-19. **Test date:** 2026-11-19.

**Reported/observed package SHA-256:** not recorded.

## Procedure and coverage

Test build flashed from the SD card; checked boot, RC Mode at the end of Shooting Menu 1, Live ND Shooting after High Res Shot, the page's three rows; set values, powered off and on, checked them again.

- Boots normally with code in the space after section 3 and ready-bit guards on the boot-time hooks.
- Rows and page appear where planned; values survive power-off.
- An earlier placement after section 7 boot-looped and was recovered from the card (see the section-load-order hazard).

## Limits and assumptions

- One camera, one owner report, one session.
- Other settings after restart and a battery-pull case are not reported.
